question: Does Jackson Jr serialize an enum constant with its own constant-specific class body as its JSON string name?
control: An ordinary enum constant uses its JSON string name.
domain: Both constants of one public enum. The observed outputs are the exact JSON string name or a one-field JSON object containing the enum's declaring class name. Other JSON and mapping exceptions have separate codes.

basis.text: Detect whether a class is an enum or a subclass of an enum

scopeNotes: The original JVM identified the old object as {"declaringClass":"ReferenceAPI$Item"} during independent reference construction. The two-copy caller derives the defining class name from its own copy.
assistance: curator-supplied public caller and expected results only in the matched lane
